notes.title: Update Patch v.1.3.0.10
notes.notes:
[b]<Addition of Content>[/b]
-Added the "Advanced" combat setting.
-Added the Bottomless Labs to Terminal Creed.
-Added five new Customs.
-Added four new weapons.
-Added the six winning pieces of the fan-art contest.

[b]<Balance Adjustments>[/b]
-Reduced the number of levels of Terminal Karma from four to three.
-Changed the Keepers of each level in Terminal Karma to those of the other stages.
-Banned MC skills from use in the Virtual Missions.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.2.4
notes.notes:
[b]<Addition of Content>[/b]
-Added the Christmas Custom gears "Stellar Pixie" and "Snow Pixie."

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which the camera angle would not return to normal after a Take-down.
-Fixed an issue in which Rona can get caught outside the gate at the start of battle.
-Fixed an issue in which Rona could get immobilized at the same time as defeating a boss.
-Fixed an issue in which Chain-skills would be unleashed multiple times at once.
-Fixed an issue in which Shutty would malfunction when unleashing ranged attacks.
-Fixed an issue in which, when the MC skill "Ice Time" is unleashed while an enemy is evading, that enemy would freeze out of bounds.
-Fixed an issue in which Core energy would not be lost when receiving damage while the bugged Core "Leaky Core" is installed.
-Fixed an issue in which operation by controller would malfunction.

[b]<Balance Adjustments>[/b]
-Altered settings so that Core Chargers would appear randomly in the battlefield.
-Lowered the probability of Core Chargers dropping when viral Cores are installed.
-Lowered the HP of Keepers in Terminal Karma.
-Lowered the HP of high-hazard level robots.
-Altered settings so that enemies are not knocked back when hit by Rona with the Super-core "Dash" installed.
-Lowered the attack power of the weapon "Four Tigers."

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.1.1
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which the frame rate would drop during the animation at the start of the stage.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.1.0
notes.notes:
[b]<Addition of Content>[/b]
-Added the Halloween Custom gear "Pompous Witch."

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which the transport vessel could be activated during the animation for boarding a Powerbot.
-Fixed an issue in which the Super-core installation screen would not close after installing a Super-core.

[b]<Balance Adjustments>[/b]
-Adjusted the overall balancing of Super-cores.
-Adjusted the judgement standards for the Clear Rank of Terminal Creed.
-Adjusted the overall balancing of the last floor of each stage.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.13 HOTFIX
notes.notes:
A hotfix has been applied to Update Patch v.1.2.13.

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which, in the Controd stage, the number of combos was being displayed for the stage results, when combos do not apply to the Controd stage.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.13
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which a shield would not be generated when Controd's gear is equipped.
-Fixed an issue in which HP cans could not be obtained.
-Fixed an issue in which the spam on the security camera caused by the bugged Core "Spam" would not appear properly.
-Fixed an issue in which NPCs would continue to appear after it has become impossible to clear that quest.

[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
-Increased the rate of occurrence of NPC quests.
-Altered settings so that the location of falling traps will constantly be displayed for Level 2 onward in the Lighton stage.
-Altered settings so that Controd's gear generates two shields instead of one when equipped.

[b]<Other>[/b]
-Added sound effects for when weapon exchange and the use of MC skills become possible.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.12
notes.notes:
[b]<Addition of Content>[/b]
-Added a Custom gear that pixelates Rona in the same way as the bugged Core "Disfigurement."

[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which the camera angle would not return to normal after a Take-down.
-Fixed an issue in which, in the System Upgrader, the feature MC Skill Optimization was not being applied properly.
-Fixed an issue in which the Core Charger could not be operated properly.
-Fixed an issue in which, when the MC skill Chill Time gets unleashed, enemies would begin to move abnormally.
-Fixed an issue in which the spacing between text lines was displayed improperly.
-Fixed some other minor issues.

[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
-Adjusted the rate of occurrence of NPC quests.
-Altered settings so that the recovery tool can be used from the start of the game.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.11
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which, in the System Upgrader, the feature MC Skill Optimization was being displayed as "ROLLING ATTACK," and when selected, the upgrade process would not complete.
-Fixed some other minor issues.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.10
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which large enemies would stick out of the battlefield,
  when Rona handles them with the Super-core "Ace Grabber" installed.

[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
-Adjusted the balancing of several weapons.
-Adjusted the judgement standards for the battle stages.

[b]<Other>[/b]
-Fixed some in-game text issues.
-Fixed some text issues with the Steam Achievements.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.9
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which enemies would stop attacking Rona.
-Fixed an issue in which installing the Mini-core "Vaccine"
    would not prevent bugged Cores from emerging.
-Fixed an issue in which, when an MC skill is used shortly after the start of battle,
    MC energy was not consumed.
-Fixed an issue in which Rona could receive damage while in a conversation in the battlefield.
-Fixed an issue in which, in certain stages, Rona could receive damage after clearing a battle.
-Fixed an issue in which, in the Gigantic stage, some objects would not appear
    and Rona was able to run out of the battlefield.
-Fixed an issue in which, when aboard the Powerbot "Hyper Armour," the installation of the Super-core "Over Charge" would prevent Rona from performing Charge attacks.
-Fixed an issue in which, when the Mini-core "Unlimited Battery" gets installed
    when Rona's battery is depleted, the battery would not recharge.
-Fixed an issue in which, on the first floor of the Faceless stage, some traps would not operate properly.
-Fixed an issue in which, in Schrödinger's quest, the quest would not end properly.

[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
-Adjusted the number of levels from four to three for all stages, excluding the final stage.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.8
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue with the text that is displayed after clearing Terminal Creed.
-Fixed an issue in which the exploration percentage for Terminal Karma would not reach 100%.
-Fixed an issue in which Rona would fall through the ground, under certain conditions, when using the weapon "Jumper."


[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
-Adjusted the judgement standards for clearing Terminal Creed.
-Adjusted the accomplishment standards for the Steam Achievements "Weapon Showcase" and "Drone Harnesser."
-Adjusted the accomplishment standards for the Challenges "Weapon Showcase" and "Drone Harnesser."
-Adjusted the number of battles in each stage.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.7
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue with the button guide for unboarding a Powerbot.
-Fixed an issue with the damage amount displays.
-Fixed an issue in which Rona would teleport in front of
  airborne enemies when using the skill for the weapon "Jumper."

[b]<Improvements>[/b]
-Altered settings so that Core-Connect is activated by installing three Cores,
  regardless of their type (Mini-core or bugged Core).
-Altered settings so that defeated enemies and objects in the battlefield
  can be destroyed with the Battle Grenade.

[b]<Balance Adjustments>[/b]
-Adjusted the balancing of the Mini-core "Skill Dope."

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.6
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed an issue in which, when a Powerbot expires while not in a battle, Rona would become uncontrollable.
-Fixed an issue in which Rona can run out of the battlefield under certain conditions.
-Fixed an issue in which clearing the Flyer stage would not become registered properly.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.5
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
-Fixed a bug that was occuring when installing the bugged Core "Power Outage."
-Fixed an issue in which Rona would run out of the stage area
  when performing the skill for the weapon "Jumper," during the Gigantic battle.
-Fixed an issue in which, for certain weapons,
  it was possible to attack the boss before the battle starts.
-Fixed improper controller button displays.

[b]<Adjustments>[/b]
-Adjusted the bloom.
-Adjusted the level of resolution drop for the bugged Core "Pixelate."
-Adjusted the difficulty of some Challenges

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.4
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
- Fixed and adjusted balancing for an issue in which the weapon
  would not be displayed properly during the performance of a skill for projectile-type weapons.
- Fixed an issue in which, when Rona is attacked while Grabbing an enemy,
  the enemy being Grabbed freezes.

[b]<Balance Adjustments>[/b]
- Adjusted the balancing of HARD mode.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.3
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
- Fixed an issue in which the game could not be controlled properly by a controller (gamepad).
- Fixed the issue which was addressed in v.1.2.2, in which the game would not operate properly depending on the refresh rate of the monitor, because it recurred.

[b]<Unsolved Bugs>[/b]
- The issue in which the Resolution choices in the Graphic Settings are not properly displaying, is yet to be solved.

notes.title: Update Patch v.1.2.2
notes.notes:
[b]<Bug Fixes>[/b]
Temporarily fixed an issue in which the game would not operate properly depending on the refresh rate of the monitor.

notes.title: BIG ANNOUNCEMENT Regarding the Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TJDuRz4MfyvUs6NB2x/giphy.gif[/img]

We've kept everyone waiting long enough!! Right?

We are excited to finally be able to announce that
the release date of METALLIC CHILD has been set to be September 16th 2021.

We apologize for the major delay.
We will continue working to improve the quality of this game.

We greatly appreciate everyone's understanding.

notes.title: 『METALLIC CHILD』Developmental status Vol.16 (and Regarding the Release Date)
notes.notes:
[Regarding the Release Date]
We will be announcing the release date soon!
Please allow us some more time.

Now, allow us to move onto this week's contents!

[Your First Obstacle, Maybe?]
At the end of each stage level await robots known as Keepers.
I think their purpose is self explanatory, right?
Brace yourself when you enter your first Nest!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lTyDgzyMnDiS0bAyWE/giphy.gif[/img]

[The Roller]
This roller-like robot unleashes swift, stealth attacks.
Just when you thought you escaped harm's way…yeah, it's not done attacking!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fLxYFyMcrfwsMEDVZF/giphy.gif[/img]

[The Big Hand]
This hand-shaped robot……quite creepy, by the way……
Just make sure you don't let it take hold of you. Bad news.
Look at it treat Rona like a fly!!
This guy's really tricky, beware.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/gHUVoCNoBafgCWwpcf/giphy.gif[/img]

[The Cerberus-looking Guy]
Three heads, all spitting out fire!
Pretty intense, but it needs time to build up this attack, so it's not hard to predict!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/egoywXC8BXhd6V1ZoY/giphy.gif[/img]

[The Wyvern]
As can be expected, this guy attacks from midair.
This wide-ranged bombardment might give you trouble at first…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/k6EBkTZrG86w6SqUvq/giphy.gif[/img]


That's it for this week...

Next week's issue will be:
Put Those Gimmicks to Good Use!

They're Not Just Decorations…you know?

The latest captures of the Nintendo Switch version of METALLIC CHILD is available now on Indie World 2021.4.15!
This is the Japanese version of "Indie World" in which the latest indie games, to be released on Nintendo Switch, are showcased.

These captures are of the Switch version, and the user interface differs from that of Steam.
However, the video also includes newly-released special artwork, so do check it out!
